summary: @or-sdk/permissions-lambda preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-transformed script (per-function property-lookup objects, `_0x...` identifiers) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs it against the bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-transformed blob (string-array rotator `WV8StW`, large mixed constant table `n7gIxM`, char-code decoder `hc1jfK9`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose name does not reflect its contents and which is executed only via the freshly downloaded Bun binary rather than by anything under `dist/`. The package is advertised as an AWS Lambda permissions SDK and has no functional need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or execute an opaque bundled blob under it at install time. Running `npm install` therefore automatically executes attacker-staged code on the installer's host under the installer's privileges, with the alternate-runtime step specifically evading Node-based supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
